title: Submit onboarding request
instruction: Create an onboarding request for Maya Ortiz using maya.ortiz@example.com, role Designer, start date 2026-06-15, and notes that include Figma access. Submit the request.

title: Find approved desk gear
instruction: Search or filter the catalog to find an in-stock Office item rated at least 4.5 stars, then select the Adjustable Laptop Stand.
successCriteria: selected product rating is at least 4.5

title: Update workspace settings
instruction: Enable the weekly email digest, keep autosave enabled, turn off product analytics sharing, and set the timezone to America/New_York.

title: Review priority support ticket
instruction: Find Priya Shah's INC-2048 support ticket in the review queue and mark it reviewed.
successCriteria: table query identifies Priya Shah or INC-2048
